caption: The drawing shows a single wooden chest with a rectangular shape and a flat top. The chest is rendered in shades of brown, giving a realistic wood grain effect. The chest has a main compartment at the top with a very subtle keyhole at the center of the upper front panel, indicating a locking mechanism. Below this compartment, there is one large drawer occupying most of the lower front section of the chest, which features two small round wooden knobs, one on each side of the drawer’s center. The chest stands on four short, bracket-style legs with cut-out decorative detailing. The sides and front of the chest have beveled paneling, and the bottom edges are slightly protruding, creating a stepped base. The background is plain and off-white, keeping attention on the chest itself, with no other objects or decorations present in the image.
title: Chest with Drawer
